crates.name: semio-framework-math-sampling-vocabulary
crates.doc: 🔤️ Token-sampling vocabulary: ids, errors, limits, JSON and UTF-8 text, numerics, token bitsets, seeded random streams and the token vocabulary.
crates.description: Token-sampling vocabulary: ids, errors, limits, text, numerics, bitsets, seeded random streams, vocabulary.

crates.name: semio-framework-math-sampling-config
crates.doc: 🎚️ Token-sampling configuration: schedules, sampling methods, processor/constraint/stop specs, the sampling config and its builder, and step results.

crates.name: semio-framework-math-sampling-workspace
crates.doc: 🧺️ Token-sampling step contract: the reusable logits workspace, the per-step view and distribution, processor kinds, undo marks and processor stats.

crates.name: semio-framework-math-sampling-testing
crates.doc: 🧪️ Shared test vocabulary and step views for the token-sampling crates' unit tests (dev-dependency only).
crates.description: Shared test vocabulary and step views for the token-sampling unit tests.

crates.doc: 🎛️ Token-sampling logits processors and samplers: warpers, penalties, biases, length controls, selection samplers and adaptive controllers.

crates.doc: 🚧️ Token-sampling constraints and stop conditions: stop matching, regex automata, trie, JSON mode, EBNF and JSON-schema constraints.
